description:
We are a multidisciplinary team of developers and technology enthusiasts participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our team combines expertise in web and mobile development, AI, data visualization, UI/UX, and problem-solving to build practical solutions using NASA’s open data.
For the “Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data” challenge,
summary:
FarmShift – Smart Farming with NASA Earth Observation Data

FarmShift is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform that helps farmers adapt to changing environmental conditions using NASA Earth observation data. It combines satellite-based information, local soil characteristics, crop requirements, and weather patterns to recommend suitable crops and smarter crop rotations. The platform aims to help farmers conserve water, improve soil health, manage climate risks, and make informed agricultural decisions. By transforming complex satellite data into practical insights, FarmShift makes space technology more accessible and useful for agriculture. Our mission is to support sustainable farming, strengthen food security, and build climate-resilient agricultural communities.
